retrieved_documents.text: Jingye Temple (Shaanxi) Jingye Temple () is a Buddhist temple located on the north slope of Zhongnan Mountains, in Chang'an District, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. It is the cradle of Risshū. The temple was first established in 581, at the dawn of Sui dynasty (589–618). In 624 in the 7th year of Wude period (618–626) in the Tang dynasty (618–907), master Daoxuan resided in the temple, where he taught Risshū and promulgated Buddhist doctrines. The temple was renamed ""Baiquan Temple"" (). In 665, during the reign of Emperor Gaozong (650–683), the emperor issued the decree building a stone ordination altar ().
